pack.topic: Overcoming Investor Procrastination and Fear in Coimbatore Real Estate
pack.source_script_insight: The source emphasizes that passive waiting ('baith-baith ke') achieves nothing; one must actively evaluate shortcomings, abandon comfortable hesitation, and confront challenges directly instead of running away.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Addressing Coimbatore retail buyers who endlessly delay property decisions out of hesitation, waiting for 'perfect market timing' while prices shift along Avinashi Road or Thudiyalur.
pack.visual_strategy: Uses macro close-ups of hesitation cues (tapping fingers on a phone screen showing property listings, a closed diary on a wooden desk) shifting to an active physical site visit under Coimbatore's harsh midday sun, proving that action beats hesitation.
pack.core_takeaway: Endless hesitation in property selection loses great opportunities; proactive analysis and fearless decision-making secure the right Coimbatore asset.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK: Exactly 10 seconds duration, native portrait 9:16 aspect ratio, full-screen vertical composition designed strictly for Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu audiences.

B. REALISM LOCK: 100% photorealistic physical-world footage. Absolutely no animation, CGI, cartoon, 3D render, or explainer graphics. Show authentic Coimbatore environments, local architecture, genuine materials, natural sunlight, realistic shadows, and true-to-life human interactions.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK: Subject is buyer psychology / overcoming investment procrastination. Source evidence points: 1. Passive waiting yields nothing. 2. Honest self-assessment and correction of missed opportunities is vital. 3. Success demands leaving comfort zones and facing market realities directly. Coimbatore application: addressing local investors who endlessly hesitate instead of evaluating plots or apartments on Avinashi Road or Thudiyalur.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY: Focus on physical cues of hesitation (smartphone tapping, reviewing notebooks) transitioning to active site visits, document checking, and confident handshake decisions. The generic empty-plot-to-mansion construction sequence is strictly forbidden.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY: Clean, stable mirrorless/smartphone footage, natural focal lengths, sharp textures, realistic depth of field, authentic daylight exposure without artificial grading.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN:
- Scene 1 (0.0 - 1.3s): Extreme close-up of a finger tapping a smartphone screen showing real estate listings, indoor lighting. Voiceover: 'சும்மா காத்திருந்தா'
- Scene 2 (1.3 - 2.8s): Medium shot of a hand turning pages of a personal notebook with property notes on a wooden desk. Voiceover: 'எதுவும் நடக்காது. தயக்கத்தை'
- Scene 3 (2.8 - 4.2s): Medium close-up of feet stepping out of a car onto a dusty gravel road under bright Coimbatore sun. Voiceover: 'விட்டு, விலை உயர்வை'
- Scene 4 (4.2 - 5.7s): Eye-level shot of an investor inspecting a survey stone on a plot. Voiceover: 'பார்த்து பயப்படாம,'
- Scene 5 (5.7 - 7.1s): Macro shot highlighting legal layout maps with a pen. Voiceover: 'சரியான இடத்தை'
- Scene 6 (7.1 - 8.6s): Medium shot of a confident handshake between buyer and seller in Coimbatore. Voiceover: 'உடனே ஆய்வு செஞ்சு'
- Scene 7 (8.6 - 10.0s): Static wide shot of a verified plot under natural daylight with minimal 'OliveTree Investors' text overlay. Voiceover: 'முடிவு எடுங்க!'

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT: Only subtle Tamil text overlays on real footage. No flashy transitions or explainer cartoons.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE: End strictly on the handshake and verified plot shot with subtle branding. No separate end card.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT: No cartoons, no 3D renders, no fake skylines, no floating buildings, no warped text, no duplicated people, no landscape framing, no black bars.
